isolation: No shared mutable state exists to isolate: the greeting endpoint is stateless and pure (fixed message, no per-caller or per-request data). Each scenario independently acquired its own OAuth token via a fresh Thunder SSO sign-in (separate PKCE parameters and, for the two-caller scenario, separate browser sessions), so no scenario's credentials or assertions depend on another's.

scenarios.rule: Only a signed-in caller may request the greeting
scenarios.scenario: A signed-in caller receives the greeting
